data.name: Meherdad
data.gender_notes: Meherdad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Meherdad is a Persian name derived from the words 'meher' meaning 'lord' or 'master' and 'dad' meaning 'giver'. This name signifies the one who is the giver of all things and the master of creation. The name Meherdad carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Meherdad usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying the ultimate provider and master in our lives.
data.etymology: Meherdad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meherdad total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مهرداد
in_arabic.long_meaning: مهراد هو اسم عربي مشتق من الكلمة العربية "مهر" وتعني المفضل، والكلمة "دار" وتعني المنزل، ومنه يُعرف المهراد بأنه الشخص المفضل للجميع في بيت المال، أو الشخص الذي يتم احتضانه من قبل الجميع، وفي الإسلام كان هناك قائد من الأتراك يُدعى المهراد الذي يعتبر من أهم الشخصيات في تاريخ الإسلام

in_urdu.name: مهرداد
in_urdu.meaning: مهراد نام جو مطلب ہر کوں ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مهراد نام ہے جس کے معنی ہیں کہ ہر کوں مقبول ہو، یہ نام عرب سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخص جو ہر کوں پسند آتا ہو، یہ نام مسلمانوں کے بیٹوں کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے اور ان کے ذاتی طور پر کے حوالے سے بہت اہمیت ہے

data.cultural_impact: In Persian culture, the name Meherdad is regarded as a distinguished and venerable name for a man. It showcases the rich Persian heritage with its deep roots in Persian history and language. The name has a regal and noble feel associated with it, especially in the context of the Persian empire of old where rulers and leaders were revered for their wisdom, power, and generosity.

Dedication and devotion to spiritual growth and God's teachings are integral to this name, thus Meherdad embodies the idea of a servant of God or divine guide. In spiritual circles, this name carries the notion of Meher Baba, an Indian spiritual master revered by millions worldwide who bore the name Meher Baba, which also translates to 'giver of the heart'.
